samples.claim_zh: 该研究通过空间转录组技术和细胞谱系追踪，首次揭示了黄瓜下位子房的发育机制，并阐明了KNOX1转录因子在葫芦科植物花器官发育和性别决定中的核心作用。

classify_evidences.text: Comparative spatial transcriptome mapping and cell lineage reconstructions in developing floral buds of cucumber and tomato, which have inferior and superior ovaries, respectively, revealed that inferior ovaries develop from accelerated receptacle growth resulting from the continuous activity of meristematic stems cells at the base of the cucumber floral organs.

To identify the major cell lineages involved in cucumber floral bud organogenesis and the mechanisms of receptacle development, we used the spatial transcriptomic data (Extended Data Fig. 3c) to generate a trajectory of floral organogenesis (TOFO), drawing on methods from the trajectory of mammal embryogenesis (TOME) analysis30.

Our cell lineage analysis revealed that the prolonged activity of the floral intercalary meristem (FIM) at the base of the floral organs in cucumber, leads to rapid growth of the receptacle, which results in inferior ovary formation.
Genetic knockout of a receptacle-specific KNOX1 transcription factor in cucumber caused arrest in receptacle growth and yielded bisexual flowers with superior ovaries similar to those of tomato.

To dissect the underlying gene expression network driving the development of the inferior ovary of cucumber, we sampled floral buds at various stages, including S1–S8, and ovaries at 0 days post anthesis (DPA) for spatial transcriptomic analysis.

analysis.evidence_judgement: 分句1‘首次揭示黄瓜下位子房发育机制’：sentence_id=2提供空间转录组+谱系追踪证据，但无‘首次’限定；sentence_id=32补充FIM持续活性机制，均未宣称首创性。分句2‘KNOX1在葫芦科…核心作用’：sentence_id=3证实KNOX1敲除导致黄瓜子房上位化及两性花，支撑其在黄瓜中的功能；sentence_id=4明确‘cucurbits’为研究对象范畴，但全文实证仅限黄瓜（C. sativus），未含南瓜、西瓜等其他葫芦科物种实验或比较数据；‘花器官发育和性别决定’并列表述：sentence_id=2/32/3均聚焦receptacle growth→ovary position→sex expression链条，未提KNOX1直接调控花器官身份（如ABCE模型）或性别决定基因（如F/f、ACS11等）。
analysis.classification_reason: ‘首次揭示’属 significance_addition（addition → significance_addition）：paper_expression=‘Comparative spatial transcriptome mapping... revealed that...’（中性发现动词）；article_expression=‘首次揭示’（强调原创性/优先权）。非 omission：背景限定删减（context_omission）体现在‘葫芦科’泛化——paper_expression=‘in cucumber’ / ‘cucurbits’（指代本研究系统，非全科推论）；article_expression=‘葫芦科植物’（taxonomic overgeneralization）。非 substitution：未替换机制（仍为KNOX1→receptacle→ovary position），故非 mechanism_substitution 或 relation_substitution。

Taken together, these findings highlight the pivotal role of KNAT2-like1 in receptacle development and ovary positioning.

Since 60% of the normal female flowers transformed into ‘superior ovary flowers’, and only some female flowers were present at the lower nodes, we determined that KNAT2-like1 is critical for receptacle development and inferior ovary formation.
These results indicate that the expression activity of KNAT2-like1 is associated with receptacle development.

Our findings support a model in which the loss of function of any one of these three genes leads to receptacle arrest and promotes stamen development; however, compared with knat2-like1 mutants, carpel initiation is also repressed in crc and er, resulting in a female-to-male sexual transition (Extended Data Fig. 8j).
